name: OOPS - Out Of Place Sorter
overview: Oops, wrong library? Move media to another library from the item menu.
description: Adds a 'Transfer media' option to the item menu and multi-select menu for administrators. Moves the files on disk to another library of the same type, rescans both libraries, and keeps everyone's watch history.

versions.changelog: Pick which folder to move into when a library has several folders.
No longer needs the File Transformation plugin: OOPS adds its menu option by itself.
